term.def: AI that senses and acts in the real world through robots or machines, not just on a screen. It combines sensors, cameras and motors with AI software.

prompt.prompt: List three repetitive physical tasks in our [warehouse/plant] that could be automated with sensors or robots, and estimate the cost of a small pilot.

quiz.q: Rediff reports that IIT Kharagpur is setting up a new Physical AI school.
quiz.why: This matches the headline from Rediff about IIT Kharagpur's new Physical AI school.

quiz.q: The Economic Times reports that Nikhil Kamath asked Silicon Valley founders if the AI boom is real or a bubble.
quiz.why: This directly restates the Economic Times headline about Kamath's question to founders.

quiz.q: AI systems can think and feel emotions the way humans do.
quiz.why: AI predicts patterns in data. It has no feelings, awareness or inner experience, no matter how natural it sounds.

quiz.q: AI tools can sometimes give confident but completely false answers.
quiz.why: This is called hallucination. It happens because AI predicts likely words, not verified facts.

quiz.q: You must know how to code to use most AI tools at work today.
quiz.why: Most workplace AI tools today use plain language chat or simple menus, no coding needed.
